title: Can Multi-modal (reasoning) LLMs detect document manipulation?
abstract: arXiv:2508.11021v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Document fraud poses a significant threat to industries reliant on secure and verifiable documentation, necessitating robust detection mechanisms. This study investigates the efficacy of state-of-the-art multi-modal large language models (LLMs)-including OpenAI O1, OpenAI 4o, Gemini Flash (thinking), Deepseek Janus, Grok, Llama 3.2 and 4, Qwen 2 and 2.5 VL, Mistral Pixtral, and Claude 3.5 and 3.7 Sonnet-in detecting fraudulent documents. We benchmark these models against each other and prior work on document fraud detection techniques using a standard dataset with real transactional documents. Through prompt optimization and detailed analysis of the models' reasoning processes, we evaluate their ability to identify subtle indicators of fraud, such as tampered text, misaligned formatting, and inconsistent transactional sums. translated_title: 多模态（推理）大语言模型能够检测文档篡改吗？
translated_abstract: 文档欺诈对依赖安全且可验证文件的行业构成重大威胁，因此需要强大的检测机制。本研究考察了最先进的多模态大语言模型（LLMs）——包括 OpenAI O1、OpenAI 4o、Gemini Flash（thinking）、Deepseek Janus、Grok、Llama 3.2 和 4、Qwen 2 和 2.5 VL、Mistral Pixtral，以及 Claude 3.5 和 3.7 Sonnet——在检测欺诈文档方面的效能。我们使用包含真实交易文档的标准数据集，对这些模型进行相互基准测试，并与以往文档欺诈检测技术的研究进行比较。通过提示词优化以及对模型推理过程的详细分析，我们评估了它们识别细微欺诈指标的能力，例如被篡改的文本、错位的格式以及不一致的交易金额。我们的结果表明，表现最优的多模态大语言模型展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究系统评估了包括 OpenAI O1、Gemini、Claude 等多种最先进多模态（推理）大语言模型在真实交易文档上检测欺诈篡改的能力，发现顶尖模型展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks state-of-the-art multi-modal (reasoning) LLMs—including OpenAI O1, Gemini, and Claude—on detecting document fraud in real transactional documents, finding that top-performing models exhibit superior zero-shot generalization.
